name: Grilling
description: Interviews you relentlessly about a plan, decision or idea, round by round, until every branch of the design tree is settled and nothing is silently assumed.
longDescription: The reusable interview primitive behind `/grill-me`, `/grill-with-docs`, `/triage`, `/wayfinder` and `/improve-codebase-architecture`. Models a plan as a **design tree** worked in **rounds**: each round asks the whole frontier (every question whose prerequisites are settled) as numbered `Q1`, `Q2` blocks, each with a recommended answer, then waits; anything depending on an open answer waits for a later round. Facts are the agent's job (sub-agents read the filesystem instead of asking you); decisions are yours. Ends when the frontier is empty, and acts on nothing until you confirm shared understanding.
